decisions.reason: Similar to the already-dropped Product A and no longer visible on the website, its results likely fall below aspirations, so management drops it.
Automatic airless spray guns are central to the firm's application technology and no clear shortfall has emerged, so management keeps it.
Manual airless spray guns serve the established customer base and fit existing manufacturing, so management keeps the product while monitoring aspirations.
The air-assisted product line extends core spray technology across several models and slack allows continued evaluation, so management keeps it.
